snippet.title: SWC2026 Location Announcement | Summoners War
snippet.description:

INTO THE LEGACY 🔥The battlefield to continue the legacy of skills and pride proven by many Summoners is opening once again!

Who will be the one and only Summoner to stand at the pinnacle of SWC2026?
We invite all Summoners to join this intense journey starting again this August.

⚔ CHINA QUALIFIER - MAIN ROUND | Xi'an, China

⚔ AMERICAS CUP | Toronto, Canada
